claims: SBI VC Trade began handling RLUSD on June 24, 2026
SBI VC Trade describes RLUSD as Japan's first Type 4 Electronic Payment Instrument at the time
SBI states the Type 4 classification is its treatment under Japanese law; RLUSD is not a US-law trust beneficial interest
SBI VC Trade is a registered Electronic Payment Instruments Exchange Service Provider
SBI VC Trade completed registration as an Electronic Payment Instruments Exchange Service Provider on March 4, 2025, enabling USDC handling in Japan

secondary_source.claim: reports the initial SBI VC Trade RLUSD listing supported Ethereum only and had a per-transfer limit around JPY 1 million

corrections_and_limitations: SBI's primary June 24 announcement does not specify which blockchain network was enabled for the Japanese VCTRADE listing.
Do not infer that SBI VC Trade's Japanese RLUSD distribution provided XRPL access merely because RLUSD exists on XRPL globally.
The Type 4 classification applies to the Japanese electronic-payment-instrument treatment of RLUSD, not to XRP or every RLUSD network.
